_note: Manual overrides for GA Congress trade data, applied after generate_ga_congress_trades.py fetches from kadoa-org/congress-trading-monitor. Keys are filer IDs from that dataset. Use _exclude to drop a filer entirely, _mergeInto to fold one filer's trades into another (dedup), and any other fields to patch filer-level values.
_note_empty: Intentionally empty. Ordinary delegation turnover needs no entry here: the generator drops filers who are not in current-members.json (previously _exclude entries for Tom Graves and Marjorie Taylor Greene), merges filers sharing a bioguideId (previously a _mergeInto for the duplicate Michael Collins records), and rebuilds office and photoUrl from the roster (previously hand-written patches for McCormick's NY-01 and Collins' GA-08, and two 404 photo URLs). Add an entry only for something the roster cannot settle -- chiefly pinning bioguideId for a filer whose surname is shared by two GA members and whose upstream office string does not disambiguate.
